2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Miami’s healthy defense catches Las Vegas without its premier matchup weapon
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Miami enters Las Vegas without a game-status injury designation, while the Raiders will be without star tight end Brock Bowers after knee surgery. That removes one of Las Vegas’ most difficult coverage problems and puts more responsibility on the Raiders’ backs and remaining pass catchers to create efficient offense. Miami still has to tackle cleanly and prevent the game from becoming a physical, possession-heavy contest. If the Dolphins control early downs and force obvious passing situations, Bowers’ absence becomes much harder for Las Vegas to hide.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Miami’s healthier receiving-defense matchup creates a cleaner path, while Las Vegas needs its run game and complementary targets to keep the Dolphins from dictating obvious passing situations.
